thread:
Nora: FYI planning to roll rwinf-ingest:2026-04-08-b2 on Thu 09:00 PT. Need a short RN, pin the image, and an internal blast cadence. I put a stub in drive: https://drive.company/releases/ingest

Devon: I'll own the RN copy. Can we pin to rwinf-ingest:2026-04-08-b2 and do a 3-stage canary: 1%, 10%, 100% with 10m gates? Prefer shorter first gate to catch immediate errors.

Kai: +1. Ops note: quiet window 08:00-11:00 PT. Oncall-Core please standby for canary gates. Also recommend pushing internal announce at gate 2.

DeployBot: /deploy start --service rwinf-ingest --image rwinf-ingest:2026-04-08-b2 --canary 1,10,100 --gate 10m

DeployBot: Canary scheduled for 2026-04-08T16:00:00Z. Will update this thread. :robot_face:

CS-Ops: Can CS get a heads-up at gate 2? We need to update KB only if schema bump. Devon, flag that in RN if present.

Devon: RN draft: "Release: rwinf-ingest 2026-04-08-b2. Changes: performance improvements on batching and a minor schema compatibility flag (backwards compatible). Rollout: 1/10/100 with 10m gates. Owners: Devon (comm), Nora (release lead), Kai (ops). Oncall: Oncall-Core. CS notified at 100% or earlier if any schema drift detected." Thoughts?

Nora: Good. Add quick rollback commands and a short evacuation checklist.

Kai: Rollback snippet to include in RN:
```
DeployBot: /deploy rollback --service rwinf-ingest --to-image rwinf-ingest:2026-03-30-stable
kubectl rollout undo deployment/rwinf-ingest
```
Add automated rollback threshold: error rate +0.75% or sustained 95p latency >600ms for 2 gates.

Oncall-Core: Added to gate watchers. Will monitor dashboards at +2m, +7m, and gate end.

DeployBot: Canary gate 1 started 1% of traffic routed to canary (1%). Monitoring tokens, latency, and errors.

Oncall-Core: Gate 1 checks: errors flat, p95 +10ms, no schema mismatch logs. Clear to advance.

DeployBot: Canary gate 2 started (10%). Posting telemetry: https://dash.company/canary/18654

CS-Ops: Received. If schema warnings appear, notify CS immediately.

Oncall-Core: Gate 2 status: slight uptick in small-file ingestion errors (+0.12%) but within threshold. No rollback.

Nora: Devon, please post internal announce to #eng-releases now with the RN link. Also schedule CS email to go at 100%.

Devon: Posted: "Rolling rwinf-ingest -> 2026-04-08-b2. Low risk. Contact Nora/Kai for rollback. RN link: <drive>. CS email scheduled for final gate." :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Rollout to 100% initiated.

DeployBot: Rollout complete 100% traffic. Status: success. :tada:

Nora: Post-deploy: Devon update changelog and tag RN as released; Kai keep monitoring for 4h; Oncall-Core remain on-call until 13:00 PT.

Devon: Changelog updated and RN pinned in drive. Thanks team.
